hero.bioHtml: Cybersecurity Business Development professional with a technical foundation in offensive and defensive security. I work with national and international vendors, distributors, and clients to turn solutions across EDR, XDR, NDR, OT security, MFA, VAPT, phishing simulation, awareness training, and SOC services into practical business recommendations.

paragraphsHtml: I am a Cyber Security Business Development professional at JasTel Network, engaging security vendors and distributors, consulting clients on their needs, and translating technical capabilities into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

My technical foundation spans offensive and defensive security: HackTheBox and national CTF competitions, controlled RAT research, Splunk-based detection engineering, and cloud security log analysis with AWS WAF, CloudFront, and ELK.

I graduated from Mahidol University with a B.Sc. in Information and Communication Technology, majoring in Computer Network. I also work part-time with Limitless Academy, supporting practical and responsible AI training for mixed-experience audiences.

experience.title: Cyber Security Business Development
pointsHtml: Engage with national and international security vendors and distributors to evaluate and position cybersecurity solutions.

Consult with clients to identify security needs and map them to appropriate products and services, including EDR, XDR, NDR, OT security, MFA, VAPT, phishing simulation, awareness training, and SOC services.
Translate complex technical security concepts into clear, business-relevant recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant (Part-time)
pointsHtml: Support weekend delivery of professional training programs on the practical and responsible use of AI.
Help participants understand technical AI concepts across a mixed-experience audience.

experience.title: Network and Security Intern
pointsHtml: Analyzed AWS WAF and CloudFront logs to evaluate cloud security posture and identify potential risks across the production environment.
Configured ELK visualizations to monitor the network status of 7-Eleven stores nationwide.

projects.title: RansomWatch TH
projects.bodyHtml: Built an automated ransomware threat-intelligence platform monitoring Thai organizations and converting public incident data into a business-development follow-up pipeline. Designed scheduled ingestion, normalization and deduplication, watchlist matching, Discord and email alerts, incident lookups, trend statistics, and sourced AI briefings. Validated reliability with 58 automated tests covering data processing, alert delivery, and timezone-safe scheduling.

projects.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting System Utilizing Splunk Free License
projects.bodyHtml: Designed and built a Splunk-based real-time monitoring system detecting phishing, DoS, cryptojacking, and brute-force attacks across endpoint and network telemetry. Implemented LINE and SMTP email alerting with severity scoring and event-history context for analyst handoff.

projects.title: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) Investigation for Prevention
projects.bodyHtml: Designed and built a controlled attacker-victim-C2 lab environment to study RAT behavior. Analyzed C2 communications, simulated persistence and data exfiltration, and translated offensive findings into practical detection signatures and prevention controls from red-team and blue-team perspectives.
